entry.title: Summer Palace · Bronze Ox
entry.note: PMTiles supplies the sculpture position. The northwest-facing head follows the photographic relationship to Kunming Lake and Longevity Hill. The carved seal-script and balustrade reliefs are simplified. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
